ruled_out_vectors.title: Operator precedence in pricing bounds check
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Solidity type system forces (uint160 | uint160) == 0 parsing; uint160 | bool is type error

ruled_out_vectors.title: Floor-only pricing bounds bypass
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Depends on CH-01 being valid; since precedence is correct, floor-only bounds work as intended

ruled_out_vectors.title: Fee amplification with extreme hopFeeBPS
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Admin-controlled fee, limitAmount guards user, amplified fee goes to protocol not attacker

ruled_out_vectors.title: CLOB afterSwapRefund reentrancy window
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Reentrancy window exists but executor can only withdraw own msg.sender-keyed balance

ruled_out_vectors.title: afterSwap-only pricing DoS via uninitialized transient slot
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Admin misconfiguration (afterSwap without beforeSwap), related to known HOOK-001

ruled_out_vectors.title: FixedHelper +1 wei reserve inflation per swap
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Intentional rounding tolerance; AMMModule balance check uses actual balanceOf not reserves

ruled_out_vectors.title: FixedHelper dual addInRange double counting
ruled_out_vectors.reason: originalAdd0 saved before modification prevents double-counting

ruled_out_vectors.title: FixedHelper unchecked underflow in _collectPositionSide
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Height system invariant maintains consumedLiquidity <= height.liquidity

ruled_out_vectors.title: FixedHelper feeGrowth stale initialization at crossing
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Fee accrual happens before height crossing in swap loop, same as Uniswap V3 pattern

ruled_out_vectors.title: FixedHelper tail removal ghost liquidity
ruled_out_vectors.reason: sideValue is position-local (startHeight to endHeight), not dependent on global currentHeight

ruled_out_vectors.title: SingleProvider zero output swap theft
ruled_out_vectors.reason: User limitAmount protects against zero output; limitAmount=0 is self-inflicted

ruled_out_vectors.title: CLOB finalize callback window for double-spend
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Duplicate of CH-03; AMM ENTERED bit preserved, CLOB re-entry limited to own balance

ruled_out_vectors.title: Direct swap transient slot cross-contamination
ruled_out_vectors.reason: AMM reentrancy guard prevents nested swaps; sequential swaps execute atomically

ruled_out_vectors.title: afterSwapRefund CLOB re-entry for MEV advantage
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Executor can re-enter CLOB but only manipulates own funds/orders, not insolvency vector

ruled_out_vectors.title: CLOB pricing bounds bypass via sub-atomic rounding
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Rounding error at most 1 unit in Q64.96 (~1/2^96 price difference), sub-atomic

ruled_out.title: Operator precedence in registryUpdatePricingBounds
ruled_out.reason: Solidity 0.8.24 type system prevents ambiguity: uint160 | bool is a type error, forcing (uint160 | uint160) == 0 parsing. Verified by InsolvencyEngineerTests.t.sol (5 tests) and AuditInsolvencyKL.t.sol:test_HR3_CH01.

ruled_out.title: Floor-only pricing bounds bypass via operator precedence
ruled_out.reason: Depends on H-R3-CH-01 being valid. Since operator precedence is correct, floor-only bounds (min=X, max=0) correctly evaluate as SET.

ruled_out.title: Fee amplification with high hopFeeBPS
ruled_out.reason: Math confirmed: hopFeeBPS=9999 gives 10000x. But admin-set, limitAmount caps user exposure, amplified fee goes to protocol. Halmos verified.

ruled_out.title: CLOB afterSwapRefund reentrancy
ruled_out.reason: afterSwapRefund lacks nonReentrant. Executor CAN re-enter CLOB but can only access own makerTokenBalance (msg.sender-keyed). No cross-user extraction.

ruled_out.title: Direct swap afterSwap-only pricing DoS
ruled_out.reason: Admin misconfiguration. Related to known HOOK-001. No attacker profit path.

ruled_out.title: FixedHelper +1 wei reserve inflation
ruled_out.reason: Intentional rounding tolerance. AMMModule:2208 uses actual balanceOf. 1M swaps * 1 wei negligible.

ruled_out.title: FixedHelper dual addInRange double counting
ruled_out.reason: originalAdd0 prevents double-counting. Code correct by construction.

ruled_out.title: FixedHelper unchecked underflow in _collectPositionSide
ruled_out.reason: Height system maintains aggregate consumption invariant. Safe given sum(position.liquidity) == height.liquidity.

ruled_out.title: FixedHelper feeGrowth stale initialization
ruled_out.reason: Fee accrual before crossing follows Uniswap V3 pattern. Q128 wrapping arithmetic correct.

ruled_out.title: FixedHelper tail removal height manipulation
ruled_out.reason: sideValue is position-local, not dependent on global currentHeight.

ruled_out.title: SingleProvider zero output swap
ruled_out.reason: limitAmount protects users. LP controls price. Standard AMM behavior.

ruled_out.title: CLOB finalize window after output tokens sent
ruled_out.reason: Duplicate of CH-03. AMM ENTERED bit preserved, CLOB re-entry limited to own balance.

ruled_out.title: Direct swap transient slot cross-contamination
ruled_out.reason: AMM reentrancy guard prevents nested swaps. Related to HOOK-001.

ruled_out.title: afterSwapRefund reentrancy into CLOB
ruled_out.reason: Executor can re-enter CLOB but only manipulates own funds/orders. Not insolvency vector.

ruled_out.title: CLOB pricing bounds bypass via rounding
ruled_out.reason: Rounding error is at most 1 unit in Q64.96 (~1/2^96 price difference). Sub-atomic.

summary: All 15 H-R3 hypotheses investigated and dismissed. No exploitable insolvency vectors found. Codebase is well-hardened: balance checks at AMMModule:2208 use actual balanceOf, limitAmount protects users from fee amplification, reentrancy guards prevent AMM interleaving, and CLOB re-entry during afterSwapRefund is limited to executor's own funds. The strongest lead (H-R3-CH-03/CH-06/HH-02 CLOB reentrancy) has a real reentrancy window but no cross-user extraction path.
